message: In the twin-rack cold room enclosure (C4), Sam, the hinged door leaf and perimeter seal has air leakage risk that adds to cooling load. To check it I used conduction calculation (the door conduction estimate (E10)). I found 13.8 watts conduction for 0.9 by 1.9 metre door at 35 kelvin lift, according to Indian cold-room panel maker ISMAP, 2024. I propose 90 millimetre insulated hinged door with double magnetic gasket plus cam lock and step threshold. My position: not ready because night power closure by others is still open. In the 100 millimetre Polyurethane insulated enclosure (PU, closed-cell foam panels) (C4), Maya, the transportable joints and sunlit roof has heat ingress and service risk. To check it I used plan and section layout (the door and canopy detail sketch (E11)). I found cam-lock panels with 150 millimetre vented Photovoltaic shade roof (PV, sunlight-to-electricity panels) hold gain near the 216 watt wall estimate, according to American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers Handbook, 2022. I propose demountable cam-lock Polyurethane (PU) panels with replaceable gaskets under vented shade canopy. My position: not ready because system autonomy still needs sign-off.
